comment: Default voicing category templates for Dadabe v0.1 (per D20). Categories are evaluated in priority order; the first matching template wins. The final 'spread' category is a fallthrough catch-all so every emitted voicing carries a non-null category. User-extensible via filesystem overlay (per E9).

functionClasses.comment: Named function-equivalence classes used inside templates. A pipe-delimited form (e.g. '3|b3') in a pattern is shorthand for one of these classes; classes here let users name new ones without re-typing the alternatives.

categories.name: triad
categories.description: 3-note chord-tone voicing of a triad — only root/third/fifth (and altered/suspended variants).

categories.name: shell
categories.description: Rootless or near-rootless 2-3 note voicing emphasizing 3 and 7; no 5, no extensions.

categories.name: drop-2
categories.description: Close-voiced 4-note 7th chord with the 2nd voice from top dropped an octave. One template per inversion (bass = 5, 7, 1, 3 of the close-voiced source).

categories.name: drop-3
categories.description: Close-voiced 4-note 7th chord with the 3rd voice from top dropped an octave. One template per inversion (bass = 3, 5, 7, 1 of the close-voiced source).

categories.name: spread
categories.description: Fallthrough catch-all: any voicing not matching the more specific categories above. Typically applies to 4+ note voicings with wide intervals, and to 3-note voicings that aren't pure triads.

ruleSchema.comment: Rule types the classifier must support. Each match entry is an object combining one or more of these rules; ALL rules in an entry must hold for the entry to match.
ruleSchema.noteCount: integer — sounded (non-muted) string count must equal this exactly
ruleSchema.noteCountRange: [min, max] — sounded string count must fall in this inclusive range
ruleSchema.allFunctionsIn: [function*] — every sounded note's function must be a member of this set
ruleSchema.requireFunctions: [fn-class*] — at least one sounded note must satisfy each class (a class is '<function>' or 'a|b|c' or a named class name)
ruleSchema.forbidFunctions: [fn-class*] — no sounded note may satisfy any of these classes
ruleSchema.functionSequenceLowToHigh: [fn-class*] — sounded notes, in ascending pitch order, must satisfy each class at the corresponding index; sequence length must equal sounded-string count
ruleSchema.adjacentIntervalMinSemitones: integer — every adjacent interval (low to high) between sounded notes must be ≥ this value
